content.caption: Operation: Golden Cracker is a go! Step one: climb the mountain of cushions. Step two: reach the snack bowl. Current status: I have successfully become a very round, very stuck orange ball.
content.scene: A chubby orange tabby named 阿橘 is wedged halfway between two velvet sofa cushions, his hind legs kicking playfully in the air while his cream-colored paws grasp at nothingness. Hand-painted book illustration style with soft, natural morning sunlight filtering through a window, highlighting his amber eyes and textured fur.
content.topic: A tiny mission to reach a snack bowl ends in a cozy, accidental trap.
